quick.description: Fast, effectively free executor for a small, straightforward change with a clear approach and simple verification. Do not choose when important design or debugging uncertainty remains.

workhorse.description: Default cost-conscious model for planned implementation and sustained multi-turn work. Choose when the path is credible, even if the work uses substantial context or many tool calls.

workhorse-zai.description: OpenAI-quota-saving replacement for the workhorse. Choose for ordinary planned implementation when the OpenAI 5-hour quota is below 20% or the weekly quota is below 10%.

deep.description: Very expensive model for hard, consequential decisions: the path is unclear, competing approaches need careful evaluation, or prior attempts failed for uncertain reasons. Do not choose merely because work is long or broad.
